description:
Clean a land parcel dataset by repairing invalid geometries (self-intersections).

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the layer from /home/ga/GIS_Data/parcels_with_errors.geojson. This dataset contains 3 parcels, one of which has a 'bowtie' self-intersection error.
3. Open the Processing Toolbox (Processing > Toolbox).
4. Search for and run the 'Fix geometries' tool.
5. Select the parcel layer as Input.
6. Save the Fixed Geometries output to a file: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/parcels_fixed.geojson (choose GeoJSON format).
7. Verify the new file contains valid geometries.
